verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens portal lists a first-party 'Data and Image Subscriptions' offering and a 'Farm Product Monthly Subscription'. Both point to bulk registry extracts delivered without scraping, but the evidence is only a pair of menu titles, with no detail on format, content, access or cost. missing for 10: documented dataset contents and formats, download or delivery mechanism, update cadence, terms and pricing, independent or hands-on confirmation that the extracts are obtainable.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
